author: Codex
scope: Individual habit Progress/statistics; no application implementation
selection: Original IDs cited in prior progress report habit-type sections, plus targeted contrary evidence on actual quantities, schedules, percentages, clutter, streaks and year views. Purposive verification, not fresh whole-corpus coding.
theme_counts: Recomputed from prior TSV, not independently recoded. Themes overlap; app IDs include separate store datasets. Not market prevalence or feature ranking.
limits: No live competitor device walkthrough; official documentation and supplied screenshots inspected.
Some prior codes omit relevant originals or conflate adjacent features.
Cached Git refs inspected; live merge/CI state not confirmed.
Recommendations and mockups are proposals, not user-tested decisions.
